title: How GTA 6 Might Make RDR2 Look Old According to Fans
description: Explore Reddit community discussions on how Rdr2's incredible details compare to the anticipated technical leaps and massive scale of GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Lasting Legacy of RDR2's Details

Years after its initial release, Rockstar Games' *Red Dead Redemption 2* continues to amaze players with its staggering level of depth. A recent discussion on the Reddit community r/GTA6 by user /u/Pistoluislero highlighted this phenomenon, noting that even while pushing for 100% completion in story mode years later, players can still stumble upon random events and hidden interactions they have never encountered before. The sheer aliveness of the game world remains an incredible achievement.

## Expectations for GTA 6's Technical Leap

This enduring admiration naturally fuels massive anticipation for *GTA 6*. Community members are actively imagining how Rockstar's next title will build upon the foundations laid by RDR2. Fans in the thread speculated about what a massive technical leap could mean for the franchise, dreaming of a world featuring significantly expanded maps, doubled animation sets, richer NPC interactions, and countless new secrets, collectibles, and world events.

It is important to note that specific multiplier estimates—such as maps being three times larger or having twice as many animations—stem purely from community speculation and personal excitement rather than confirmed official data from Rockstar Games.

## Editor's Take

*Red Dead Redemption 2* set a golden standard for open-world immersion. While community enthusiasm and imaginative comparisons are a fun part of the wait for *GTA 6*, we should temper expectations with the understanding that player-generated hype often outpaces reality. Nevertheless, the anticipation for how Rockstar will top their previous masterpiece is entirely justified.
